content.value: A quick index to the full reference entries. Scalars show effective values; arrays show shape and units.
Inputs below are values read during evaluation; a read does not always mean the value was necessary for the result.

rows.value: Allow the solver to adjust deltaT to satisfy its Courant-number controls.
Maximum Courant number used by the solver's adaptive time-step logic.
Largest time-step the solver may select when adjusting deltaT.

Select whether OpenFOAM uses system tools or compilers from its ThirdParty configuration.
Select the bit width used for OpenFOAM integer labels, such as cell and face indices.
Select the MPI implementation used when compiling parallel OpenFOAM applications.
SYSTEMOPENMPI, OPENMPI, SYSTEMMPI, MPI, MPICH, INTELMPI, USERMPI
Enable or disable OpenMP compiler and linker flags.
Select double, single, or mixed scalar precision for the compiled OpenFOAM libraries and applications.
Select the target architecture width where supported by the host compiler and operating system.
Time-step value used by the native solver. Stability and physical meaning remain solver-specific.
End value of the solver's native time coordinate; for steady solvers this can represent iteration time.
Select whether the case starts from its configured start time or the latest written time.
Starting value of the solver's native time coordinate. The solver determines its physical interpretation.
Select the condition that stops the solver.
Native write scheduling mode used by the selected tutorial.

Default interpolation scheme from cell centers to faces.
Default Laplacian scheme, including its surface-normal gradient treatment.
Fallback discretization for divergence terms without a more specific entry.

Prandtl number in the constant-transport gas model.
Number of recent time directories to retain; zero keeps all written times.
Whether the solver rereads supported dictionaries while running.
Precision used when formatting time-directory names.
Whether written output files are compressed.
Representation used for written field data.
Significant digits used when writing scalar values.
